notes.title: ::CallBack is now out of Early-Access !
notes.notes:
[h1][b]It is on, Challengers ! We've finally done it ! :D[/b][/h1]

After a little more than a year of hard work, ::CallBack can be published out of early access. It's been really great to communicate with you all along this adventure, we got tons of great feedbacks and advanced toward this point. Well, let's review what's new in the game and how your game night parties will be boosted !


[h1][b]Artificial Intelligence (AI)[/b][/h1]

You've been a lot of gamers wanting to play the game without having to always bring your friends home to do it. Now you can add AIs with simple button press on the character selection screen, with two difficulties.

First difficulty is meant to let everyone have fun and train the basics of gameplay. The second one is meant to let your train on high precision shots, dodges and blocks. Both difficulties can teamplay, so do not hesitate to play some team deathmatches !


[h1][b]Random Match[/b][/h1]

You now can launch the game with random settings (map, projectiles, score or life points) in the menu, or even at the victory screen. Rematching with tons of combinations has never been that easy !


[h1][b]Worldwide Competitions Champions[/b][/h1]

The character selection screen now features the four World Champions of ::CallBack : France, Mexico, Egypt and Japan ! They'll compete to gain the ressources needed for their countries to prosper. So, which Champion will you choose ?


All in all, it's been incredible and we hope you'll have as much fun playing ::CallBack as we did making it ! That was the last update for the game, we'll work on new projects from now on :)
Do not hesitate to join us on Discord --> https://discord.gg/cErzNDn


See you soon, Challengers !

notes.title: ::CallBack is launching Early Access on Steam !
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34235414/7c09d790997672a3671d1dce44377bc40d8879a8.jpg[/img]

Oh how this is great for us...! We worked hard on the last feedbacks players gave us, we upgraded graphics, gameplay balance, we added a better menu with tutorials... It's been intense, but it was great !

Thank you all for helping us getting this far, but know that it is only the beginning for ::CallBack, we wanna bring salty fun to your couch and that is exactly what we're gonna do !

Feel free to follow us through our social medias with this link (including Discord server to chat with us) --> https://linktr.ee/callbackgame

Please take a look at the awesome work of Tiasu, who did the musics used in the game, coming from his album Insomnia --> https://tiasu.bandcamp.com/


Again, thanks to you all, we are really happy with the result ! Let's make the game better and better ! But for now, our team need to relax... and for that, we'll play at GidyYup's home Live on Twitch (FR speaking) with lots of people, Saturday February 9th at 2pm Paris time --> https://www.twitch.tv/gidyyup


Have fun with the game, feel free to write your feedbacks in the steam forums of the game !

Sincerely,
Water Temple Studio
